decisions_time_hours: {hours, plural, one {{hours, number}h left} other {{hours, number}h left}}
decisions_time_days: {days, plural, one {{days, number}d left} other {{days, number}d left}}
decisions_empty_filtered_text: Clear the filters to see every decision that needs a person.
decisions_empty_mine_text: Take a decision from All or Unassigned to look after it.
decisions_empty_unassigned_text: Open All to see who is looking after each one.
decisions_empty_all_title: No decisions are waiting for a person
decisions_empty_all_text: Luma lists approvals, manual steps, and outcome checks here as soon as it needs someone. Connection health is shown on Home.
decisions_group_note: Each decision still needs its own response; nothing is approved in bulk.
decisions_offline_text: The list shows the decisions Luma last loaded. Responses are paused until you reconnect.
decisions_unavailable_text: {count, plural, one {{sources} didn’t answer, so its decisions are missing from this list. They aren’t resolved. Refresh to try again.} other {{sources} didn’t answer, so their decisions are missing from this list. They aren’t resolved. Refresh to try again.}}
decisions_error_stale: The list below may be out of date.
decisions_error_no_access: You no longer have access to this workspace.
decisions_pagination_total: {count, plural, one {{count, number} decision} other {{count, number} decisions}}
decisions_missing_title: This decision no longer needs you
decisions_missing_text: It was answered or expired, or you no longer have access.
decisions_placeholder_text: See why you’re needed, the exact change, and what your response does.
decisions_assign_failed: Luma couldn’t save the owner. Refresh and try again.
decisions_departed_title: This decision has left the queue
decisions_departed_text: It was answered, expired, or changed, possibly somewhere else in Luma. Its current state is shown below.
decisions_note_awaiting_other: You requested this, so someone else who can approve changes has to approve it. You can still follow it here.
decisions_note_requester_runs: Only the person who requested it can run it.
decisions_note_view_only: Your role can see this decision but can’t respond to it.
decisions_review_note_case: These are the same controls as on the issue. They check the exact proposal and its expiry again before anything changes.
decisions_review_note_run: These are the same controls as on the workflow run. They check the exact proposal and its expiry again before anything changes.
decisions_review_note_record: These are the same controls as on the record. They check the exact proposal and its expiry again before anything changes.
decisions_handover_text: The workflow did what it could and handed this to a person. Act on the record. This item leaves Needs you once Luma no longer sees the follow-up. {link}
decisions_run_failed: Luma couldn’t load the workflow run. {link}
decisions_run_gone: This run is no longer among the recent runs. {link}
decisions_case_denied: This issue is missing or you no longer have access.
decisions_empty_partial_text: Some owners didn’t answer, so their decisions aren’t listed. Refresh to try again.
decisions_follow_up_why: The workflow proposes an internal follow-up note. It does not contact the supplier.
decisions_follow_up_stale: The order or policy changed. The original requester must refresh the proposal and review the new evidence.
decisions_follow_up_note: Approval allows one internal follow-up note. The workflow checks current authority and evidence again before recording it. The note does not contact the supplier.
decisions_follow_up_replaced: This proposal replaces an older proposal. Its approval does not carry forward.
decisions_follow_up_failed: The follow-up review could not be loaded.
decisions_follow_up_gone: This proposal is no longer waiting for review. Refresh Needs you to see current work.
decisions_follow_up_saved: Your response was recorded. Execution and fresh verification are separate steps.
decisions_follow_up_approve_text: Allow this exact internal note after current permissions, policy and evidence are checked again.
decisions_follow_up_reject_text: Prevent this proposed note from being recorded.
decisions_follow_up_checked: The existing attempt was checked with an independent read. No note was dispatched.
decisions_follow_up_workflow_inactive: The original workflow is no longer active. Review the owning workflow and start a new run if this order still needs a follow-up. The old proposal cannot be renewed.
decisions_follow_up_release_unavailable: Preparing or approving new follow-up notes is currently unavailable. You can still verify an existing attempt.
decisions_follow_up_mutation_failed: The follow-up action could not be completed. Current work has been reread; review it before trying again.
decisions_answer_luma_runs: Luma will run this now, then check the result independently.
decisions_answer_requester_runs: The requester can run the approved change before its authority expires.
decisions_answer_verified: A fresh independent check confirmed the result.
decisions_answer_failed: The change failed. Open the record or run to review what happened.
decisions_answer_uncertain: The result is uncertain. Review the record before taking another action.
decisions_proposal_changed_help: Review the changed values before answering. The previous approval does not cover a different proposal.
decisions_waiting_empty: Nothing is waiting on someone else.
